body: CHANGELOG updated in emily.cli: fix(truncate): rune-aware, not byte-slice — the shared truncate() helper (17+ call sites incl. BACKLOG.md INTAKE QUEUE bullets) could cut mid-multibyte-UTF-8-char on any non-ASCII text, corrupting BACKLOG.md and making grep silently treat it as binary on some invocations. Found live while curating SKULDMARK observations today. (sess-20260809-1420-e9d3d7f8)
